name: DeviceScoreSDK-iOS
summary: iOS device performance scoring SDK based on Geekbench 6 data.
description:
A lightweight iOS device performance scoring SDK driven by Geekbench 6 benchmark data.
Returns a 0-100 score and a DeviceTier (high/mid/low) based on SoC, GPU, memory, and CPU.
Supports async/await and callback. Results are cached for 7 days.
Zero dependencies, zero permissions required. iOS 13.0+.
